page_title: FRO 4-2 SAS | Frosinone v Sassuolo 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Alessandro Prontera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' 4 - 2 Goal! Walid Cheddira plays a simple square pass into the feet of Pol Lirola (Frosinone) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 4:2.
90+6' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.

90+3' Stefano Turati pulls off a fantastic save! Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header to the top left corner of the goal, but his effort is kept out.
90+3' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
90+1' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
86' Substitution. Luca Mazzitelli makes way for Pol Lirola (Frosinone).
86' POST! Matias Soule (Frosinone) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
82' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make a change. Francesco Gelli is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
82' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
80' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card.
80' Substitution. Andrea Pinamonti walks off the pitch and Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
80' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) is given a yellow card.
76' 3 - 2 Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) gets to the ball after a big mistake by the defender and scores with a precise shot into the bottom left corner.
76' Frosinone force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
75' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
70' 2 - 2 After the corner kick, Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) directs his wonderful effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner!
69' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Enzo Barrenechea will be replaced by Luca Garritano (Frosinone).
69' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Frosinone.

68' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alessandro Prontera with no other option than to blow for a foul.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) coming on for Daniel Boloca.
66' Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
63' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is adjudged offside.
62' Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
61' The Frosinone players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
58' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Frosinone for a penalty. Play continues.
57' The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
57' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
56' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is awarded a yellow card.
54' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
53' Substitution. Nedim Bajrami is replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo).
52' Alessio Dionisi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) replacing Armand Lauriente.
52' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Vina trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo).
52' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
51' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
49' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
46' Half-time substitution. Eusebio Di Francesco decided to make a change. Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) is replaced by Giuseppe Caso.
46' Half-time substitution. Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) is replaced by Caleb Okoli.
46' The whistle blows and Alessandro Prontera starts the second half.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
45+4' 1 - 2 Goal! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alessio Cragno into the bottom left corner.
45+4' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+3' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+3' It’s a PENALTY to Frosinone after the VAR review!
45+2' Referee Alessandro Prontera makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Frosinone. Let’s see what happens!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' One of the Frosinone players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
44' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Stefano Turati thwarts him with a nice save.
42' Now Sassuolo have a corner.
40' Sassuolo fail to score from a corner as Stefano Turati (Frosinone) leaps to collect the ball.

40' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
38' The Sassuolo players are exchanging some short passes.

38' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
34' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alessandro Prontera had an easy-decision to make.
32' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Frosinone.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.

30' Alessio Cragno pulls off a fantastic save! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
28' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

24' 0 - 2 It's in! Jeremy Toljan spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. The score is now 0:2.
21' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Matias Soule (Frosinone), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
19' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
16' Daniel Boloca (Sassuolo) brings an opponent down and Alessandro Prontera interrupts the game.
14' Matias Vina (Sassuolo) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
13' Anthony Oyono floats over a peach of a cross towards the penalty spot. Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) wins the ball, but sends a poor header well wide of the left post.
10' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

7' 0 - 1 Goal! Matias Vina displays great vision and sends a pass to Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 0:1.
6' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
3' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

3' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Stefano Turati sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
2' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Sassuolo will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alessandro Prontera.
